items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Then I went to Professor David Jones, but they don't accept what somebody else teach you. But then he took me back over everything that they had learnt me to review it.

ctx.x: And then I… Where did you go?

Did you take any lessons or did you just learn at home? Well, I started playing from around with some of the upper grade musicians. Then I went to Professor David Jones, but they don't accept what somebody else teach you. But then he took me back over everything that they had learnt me to review it. But then I went so fast with it, well he couldn't…you know, he had to accept it.
Can you tell us anything about him? I missed him in California. He's still out there, I guess, still living in California.
